inicio.kicker: Selling with AI Program · course 1 of 5 · 8 lessons
inicio.lead: Building got easy. Trusting what was built did not. In eight lessons, you run the 43 opportunities to sell AI through a five-box filter: Consultant, Auditor, Mentor, Trainer, or building that loses value. You leave with a chosen role and a 30-day plan.
inicio.capa_alt: Desk seen from above with paper cards in five columns and the title 43 Opportunities.
inicio.aulas_sub: First the filter and the funnel. Then the 43, in six groups. At the end, a role and a 30-day plan.

itens: People who want to sell AI services to companies and don't know where to start yet.
People who already build websites, agents or automations and feel they compete only on price.
People who want to choose a role built on trust instead of following the trendy opportunity.

blocos.t: What you'll be able to do
itens: Sort any opportunity into one of the five boxes and cut it by the five criteria.
Run the 15-minute diagnostic conversation and propose the next paid step.
Turn a build (website, scheduling, store) into part of a trusted service.
Leave with a chosen role and a 30-day plan with goals in numbers.

blocos.t: Where this course fits in Professional 2030
itens: Professional 2030 has four roles: Consultant, Auditor, Mentor and Trainer. All four sell trust, not building.
This course is the front door: it shows the four roles across the 43 opportunities so you can choose yours.
Common base it uses: AI without hype, and ethics and limits (saying what you don't do).
